title: Don't store what you can calculate

slides.say: If you can calculate something from props or other state while rendering, it should not be state.
Full name here is redundant. Every change handler must remember to update it too, or it gets out of sync.
Instead, compute it during render. Setting first or last triggers a re-render, and full name is fresh every time.

slides.text: Less state = fewer things to keep in sync.
slides.say: Takeaway: less state means fewer things that can get out of sync.
